title: WSFrame
description:
Session transport envelope — one frame, either direction.

Two jobs, one shape:
  1. The wire format between the app and whatever is on the other end of the realtime connection.
  2. The on-disk record format. SessionRecorder appends one of these per line to a .jsonl in Documents. That is why `dir` is on the frame rather than implied by the socket: a replayed log has no socket.

NOTE ON `ops`: ops arrive on the MODEL connection, not from our own server. Our server has two REST endpoints and is not in the op path. A frame with type=`ops` in a recorded log came from the model.

Exactly one payload field is populated per frame, selected by `type`. The others are absent. This is a discriminated union written flat, because a JSON-Schema oneOf generates unusable Swift.

t.description: Epoch milliseconds. Monotonic within a recorded session; replay honours the deltas.

type.description: client_to_server: audio | context | applied | tap.  server_to_client: hint | ops | speech | clarify | error.
type.title: WSFrameType

audio.description: client_to_server. PCM16 mono. The recorder writes these with `pcm_b64` elided by default — 24kHz audio is ~48KB/s and it makes the log undiffable.

applied.description: client_to_server. An op that landed, WITH its constraint_report — this is the tool result that lets the model narrate the adjustment.

hint.description: server_to_client. Fire this the instant intent is recognised, before the ops exist — a highlight at 300ms is what makes 1.2s feel instant.

ops.description: server_to_client. Intent only; every pose in here is recomputed by the on-device solver before anything is drawn.

clarify.description: server_to_client. The ask-don't-guess path, taken when ranked_candidates are within 0.1.

pcm_b64.description: Base64 PCM16LE. Empty string in a recorded log where audio was elided.

text.description: Short caption for the UI pill. Not spoken.
Transcript of what is being spoken. Recorded even when the audio is elided.

question.description: Read aloud verbatim. Should name a distinguishing feature, not an id: 'the one by the window, or the one by the door?'

candidates.description: Entity ids, in the same order as the question names them. The UI highlights these while the question plays.

recoverable.description: False means tear down and re-mint a token.
